pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large irregular polygons with sub-angular edges. Individual regions on the mid-flank exhibit higher spatial area with relatively smooth pixel gradients at the boundaries. Neck patches are more elongated with sharper angularity.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned inter-patch spaces. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. Pixel thickness is non-uniform, showing slight narrowing at the center-point of the flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the neck mane. The mane texture is clearly defined against the background pixels.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A localized dip or structural gap is visible in the mane line at the junction between the lower neck and the shoulder hump.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A deep vertical linear indentation or furrow is present on the mid-flank, creating a distinct mechanical disruption in the continuous patch geometry.
